subject: math

hotspots.label: Dividend
hotspots.description: The dividend is the total being shared — the 12 cubes waiting to be dealt into the bowls.
hotspots.positionHint: The pile of 12 cubes on the left of the mat.

hotspots.label: Divisor
hotspots.description: The divisor is the group size — the 4 bowls the cubes get shared into.
hotspots.positionHint: The row of 4 empty sharing bowls on the right of the mat.

hotspots.label: Quotient
hotspots.description: The quotient is the answer — how many cubes end up in each bowl (3).
hotspots.positionHint: The label plate over each filled bowl showing the count 3.

hotspots.label: Repeated subtraction
hotspots.description: Division can be read as subtracting the divisor again and again — 12 − 4 − 4 − 4 reaches zero after 3 steps.
hotspots.positionHint: The horizontal track at the front showing 12 → 8 → 4 → 0.
hotspots.function: Shows division as repeated subtraction counting the groups.

visualStyleNotes: Math palette, Anatomy Atelier bar: warm off-white/paper background (#F7F3EC) with soft radial vignette, no floor grid, no props. A pile of cubes on a mat, a row of sharing bowls, and a repeated-subtraction track along the front. Soft neutral studio light, no rim-light glow, no bloom, no emissive. Strong saturated color reserved for the small flat hotspot dots (grid-blue / amber / molecular-green / coral from the Math palette). Specimen-quality clean-3D, not cartoon, not cluttered.
materialNotes: Metallic-roughness PBR, metallic=0 everywhere. Cubes: warm off-white (roughness ~0.5). Bowls: soft warm-grey shallow cylinders (roughness ~0.6). Track: ink-grey strip with warm paper step labels (12, 8, 4, 0). Mat: soft warm-grey (roughness ~0.85). Quotient plates: warm amber with ink text. No emissive channels anywhere — highlights handled by app runtime UI.
assetBrief:
SUBJECT: division as equal sharing and repeated subtraction — 12 cubes dealt into 4 bowls of 3, with a stepping track along the front.

GEOMETRY: Mat (thin rounded slab ~4 wide). Dividend pile: 12 unit cubes clustered at x ≈ −1.0, z ≈ 0, y ≈ 0.3. Bowls: 4 shallow rounded bowls spaced along x ≈ 0.5..1.6 at z ≈ 0. A Deal action (app-driven) distributes the cubes one at a time so each bowl finishes with 3. Repeated-subtraction track: a low strip at y ≈ 0.05, z ≈ 0.55 with step markers 12, 8, 4, 0 that light up as groups are dealt.

LAYERS (toggleable): (1) dividend pile / shared state; (2) quotient count plates on bowls; (3) repeated-subtraction track stepping.

CAMERA: head-on from +z with slight downward tilt frames the pile, bowls, and track; calm, minimal chrome. Budget 6-11k triangles. Named nodes: Mat, DividendPile, Bowls (4), QuotientPlates, TrackSteps, DealLights. All labels are hotspot dots in the app layer.
